neighbours.label: evaluative adjectives of depth and weight (fundamental, lasting, serious, vital) before an abstract noun, not size or number adjectives
fire: Her work raised fundamental questions about how memory forms.
The trip left a lasting impression on all of us.
This is a serious study of rural poverty in the region.
Clean water plays a vital role in public health.
The treaty rests on fundamental principles of human rights.
The teacher had a lasting influence on my career.
Critics called the novel a serious meditation on grief.
He made fundamental changes to the way the company is run.

The trip left a few photos for all of us.
This is a short study of rural roads in the region.
Clean water plays a daily role in cooking and washing.
The treaty rests on twelve pages of signatures.
The teacher had a red car parked outside my school.
Critics called the novel a long book about a family.
He made minor changes to the color of the company logo.
